name: VideoVault Premiere Extension
releaseNotes:
- October 17, 2026
- A VideoVault panel opened after its clips were linked to the VideoVault drive now shows what was linked (for half an hour), instead of "Ready for project actions."
- Tip for editors on the drive: if Premiere shows "Link Media" when a project opens, click Cancel. VideoVault links the clips to the drive by itself.
